CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.clinahir_admin_prospects(p_search text DEFAULT ''::text, p_stage text DEFAULT ''::text, p_page integer DEFAULT 0, p_city text DEFAULT ''::text, p_website text DEFAULT ''::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'prospects', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t)) from (
      select id, center_name, city, address, category, phone, email, listing_url, website_url, rating, review_count,
        instagram_url, facebook_url, tiktok_url, online_booking_available, main_gap, gap_evidence,
        source_name, source_url, qualification_stage, whatsapp_opt_in_at, whatsapp_opt_in_evidence,
        notes, created_at, updated_at
      from public.clinahir_prospects
      where (p_stage = '' or qualification_stage = p_stage)
        and (p_city = '' or normalized_city = lower(trim(left(p_city,120))))
        and (p_website = '' or (p_website = 'with' and website_url is not null) or (p_website = 'without' and website_url is null))
        and (p_search = '' or center_name ilike '%' || left(p_search,120) || '%'
          or city ilike '%' || left(p_search,120) || '%'
          or address ilike '%' || left(p_search,120) || '%'
          or category ilike '%' || left(p_search,120) || '%'
          or phone ilike '%' || left(p_search,120) || '%'
          or email ilike '%' || left(p_search,120) || '%')
      order by created_at desc limit 25 offset greatest(0, least(p_page,10000))*25
    ) t), '[]'::jsonb),
    'total', (select count(*) from public.clinahir_prospects
      where (p_stage = '' or qualification_stage = p_stage)
        and (p_city = '' or normalized_city = lower(trim(left(p_city,120))))
        and (p_website = '' or (p_website = 'with' and website_url is not null) or (p_website = 'without' and website_url is null))
        and (p_search = '' or center_name ilike '%' || left(p_search,120) || '%'
          or city ilike '%' || left(p_search,120) || '%'
          or address ilike '%' || left(p_search,120) || '%'
          or category ilike '%' || left(p_search,120) || '%'
          or phone ilike '%' || left(p_search,120) || '%'
          or email ilike '%' || left(p_search,120) || '%')),
    'cities', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(city order by city) from (select distinct city from public.clinahir_prospects) c), '[]'::jsonb),
    'counts', (select jsonb_build_object(
      'total', count(*), 'review', count(*) filter (where qualification_stage='review'),
      'qualified', count(*) filter (where qualification_stage='qualified'),
      'opted_in', count(*) filter (where whatsapp_opt_in_at is not null),
      'no_website', count(*) filter (where website_url is null)
    ) from public.clinahir_prospects)
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.clinahir_admin_snapshot(p_search text DEFAULT ''::text, p_stage text DEFAULT ''::text, p_page integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select jsonb_build_object(
 'leads',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t)) from (select external_id,company_name,contact_name,email,phone,city,message,role,priority,form_type,landing_page,utm_source,utm_medium,utm_campaign,submitted_at,daily_command_status,daily_command_attempts,daily_command_last_error,admin_stage,admin_notes from public.clinahir_leads
 where (p_stage='' or admin_stage=p_stage) and (p_search='' or company_name ilike '%'||left(p_search,120)||'%' or contact_name ilike '%'||left(p_search,120)||'%' or phone ilike '%'||left(p_search,120)||'%' or email ilike '%'||left(p_search,120)||'%')
 order by submitted_at desc limit 25 offset greatest(0,least(p_page,10000))*25)t),'[]'::jsonb),
 'total',(select count(*) from public.clinahir_leads where (p_stage='' or admin_stage=p_stage) and (p_search='' or company_name ilike '%'||left(p_search,120)||'%' or contact_name ilike '%'||left(p_search,120)||'%' or phone ilike '%'||left(p_search,120)||'%' or email ilike '%'||left(p_search,120)||'%')),
 'summary',(select jsonb_build_object('total',count(*),'new',count(*) filter(where admin_stage='new'),'qualified',count(*) filter(where admin_stage='qualified'),'won',count(*) filter(where admin_stage='won'),'attention',count(*) filter(where daily_command_status in ('blocked','exhausted'))) from public.clinahir_leads),
 'analytics',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t)) from (select * from public.clinahir_conversion_daily where day>=current_date-29 order by day)t),'[]'::jsonb),
 'sources',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t)) from (select coalesce(utm_source,'Direct / unknown') source,count(*) count from public.clinahir_leads group by 1 order by 2 desc limit 8)t),'[]'::jsonb),
 'health',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t)) from public.clinahir_delivery_health t),'[]'::jsonb),
 'heartbeat',(select completed_at from public.clinahir_cron_runs where id=true),
 'whatsapp',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t)) from (select external_id,status,attempts,last_error,provider_message_id,updated_at from public.clinahir_whatsapp_jobs order by updated_at desc limit 25)t),'[]'::jsonb),
 'audit',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t)) from (select id,action,target,created_at from public.clinahir_admin_audit order by id desc limit 50)t),'[]'::jsonb)
 );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.clinahir_allow_lead(p_identifier text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare n integer; t timestamptz := clock_timestamp();
begin
 -- Only hashed email identifiers, with bounded ten-minute retention.
 delete from public.clinahir_lead_limits where window_started_at < t-interval '10 minutes';
 insert into public.clinahir_lead_limits as l values(p_identifier,t,1)
 on conflict(identifier) do update set
 requests=case when l.window_started_at<=t-interval '10 minutes' then 1 else l.requests+1 end,
 window_started_at=case when l.window_started_at<=t-interval '10 minutes' then t else l.window_started_at end
 returning requests into n;
 return n<=10;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.clinahir_finish_lead(p_id text, p_token uuid, p_status text, p_error text, p_synced_at timestamp with time zone, p_next timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 update public.clinahir_leads set daily_command_status=p_status,daily_command_last_error=p_error,
 daily_command_synced_at=p_synced_at,daily_command_next_attempt_at=p_next,
 daily_command_lock_token=null,daily_command_lock_expires_at=null
 where external_id=p_id and daily_command_lock_token=p_token;
 return found;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.clinahir_finish_whatsapp(p_id text, p_token uuid, p_status text, p_error text, p_message_id text, p_next timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 update public.clinahir_whatsapp_jobs set status=p_status,last_error=p_error,provider_message_id=p_message_id,next_attempt_at=p_next,lock_token=null,locked_until=null,updated_at=now() where external_id=p_id and lock_token=p_token;
 return '{}'::jsonb;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.clinahir_record_analytics(p_event jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 insert into public.clinahir_analytics_events(id,event_type,placement,language)
 values((p_event->>'id')::uuid,p_event->>'event_type',p_event->>'placement',p_event->>'language') on conflict(id) do nothing;
 return '{}'::jsonb;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.clinahir_record_cron(p_error boolean)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 insert into public.clinahir_cron_runs(id,completed_at,whatsapp_error) values(true,now(),p_error)
 on conflict(id) do update set completed_at=excluded.completed_at,whatsapp_error=excluded.whatsapp_error returning jsonb_build_object('ok',true);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.clinahir_replay_lead(p_id text, p_now timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 update public.clinahir_leads set daily_command_status='pending',daily_command_attempts=0,
 daily_command_last_error=null,daily_command_next_attempt_at=p_now,daily_command_lock_token=null,daily_command_lock_expires_at=null
 where external_id=p_id and daily_command_status in ('blocked','exhausted')
 and (daily_command_lock_expires_at is null or daily_command_lock_expires_at<=p_now);
 return found;
end $function$

WITH events AS (
         SELECT (clinahir_analytics_events.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Casablanca'::text)::date AS day,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE clinahir_analytics_events.event_type = 'page_view'::text) AS page_views,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE clinahir_analytics_events.event_type = 'demo_cta_click'::text) AS demo_cta_clicks
           FROM clinahir_analytics_events
          GROUP BY ((clinahir_analytics_events.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Casablanca'::text)::date)
        ), leads AS (
         SELECT (clinahir_leads.submitted_at AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Casablanca'::text)::date AS day,
            count(*) AS demo_submissions
           FROM clinahir_leads
          WHERE clinahir_leads.form_type = 'demo'::text
          GROUP BY ((clinahir_leads.submitted_at AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Casablanca'::text)::date)
        )
 SELECT COALESCE(e.day, l.day) AS day,
    COALESCE(e.page_views, 0::bigint) AS page_views,
    COALESCE(e.demo_cta_clicks, 0::bigint) AS demo_cta_clicks,
    COALESCE(l.demo_submissions, 0::bigint) AS demo_submissions
   FROM events e
     FULL JOIN leads l ON e.day = l.day;

SELECT 'daily_command'::text AS channel,
    clinahir_leads.daily_command_status AS status,
    count(*) AS count,
    min(clinahir_leads.submitted_at) AS oldest_at
   FROM clinahir_leads
  GROUP BY clinahir_leads.daily_command_status
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'whatsapp'::text AS channel,
    clinahir_whatsapp_jobs.status,
    count(*) AS count,
    min(clinahir_whatsapp_jobs.created_at) AS oldest_at
   FROM clinahir_whatsapp_jobs
  GROUP BY clinahir_whatsapp_jobs.status;
